notes: The supplied text is the LAHC Local General Education Requirements advising form (2025-2026), which it says applies to AA & AS degrees and directs AD-T students to Cal-GETC, CSU GE or IGETC sheets. It is not a section for the CSU General Education Certificate of Achievement, so no blocks were recorded.
The text states the 2025-2026 local GE requirements are shown and the 2026-2027 requirements will appear in a Catalog Addendum: catalog-year mismatch.

Many closed-list courses do appear in the local GE area lists (Areas 1A-7), but those lists define the local GE pattern, not this certificate; reasons labeled 'text is Local GE form' mean the course is printed in that form only.
The 27 semester-unit LAHC GE Plan total was not recorded as total_units because it belongs to the local GE pattern, not this award.
No outcomes or careers are printed. Reviewer should locate the actual CSU GE certificate page in the 2026-2027 catalog.
